crossRefs.note: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the…
I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.
I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble…

translations.web: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.
translations.bsb: I looked, and no man was left; all the birds of the air had fled.
translations.kjv: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
translations.asv: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
